title: 海岸濕地復育水理
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
summary: 以Nisqually河口與南灣鹽田復育為背景，逐步理解濕地工程如何連結水位、潮溝、泥砂及棲地。十個原創單元從潮汐容積、淹水歷時和通道延遲，延伸至植生阻力、蒸發濃縮、有效沖洗及前後對照，所有公式都說明適用假設與需補充的觀測。
summaryEn: Using Nisqually estuary and South Bay salt-pond restoration as context, connect water levels, channels, sediment and habitat. Ten original units progress from prism, hydroperiod and tidal lag to vegetation drag, evaporation, effective flushing and controlled before-after comparison, stating assumptions and additional observations for every model.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」與「淹水歷時與棲地高程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves" and "Inundation duration and habitat elevation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。潮汐容積可由不同水位間的面積積分得到，低灘、高灘和潮溝對體積的貢獻不同。若通道阻力使內部水位追不上外海潮位，外海潮差也不能直接套入濕地儲量曲線。教學先使用固定平面面積建立量綱概念，再要求以高程面積曲線和內外水位資料檢查簡化，避免把理想交換量當成實際淨沖洗量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone. Integrating inundated area between water levels gives tidal prism, with channels and marsh elevations contributing differently. If resistance prevents internal levels from tracking the sea, offshore tidal range cannot be applied directly to wetland storage. Begin with constant plan area, then examine elevation-area curves and internal levels, keeping gross tidal exchange distinct from net flushing of old water. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線
knowledge.text: 濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。潮汐容積可由不同水位間的面積積分得到，低灘、高灘和潮溝對體積的貢獻不同。
knowledge.textEn: After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone. Integrating inundated area between water levels gives tidal prism, with channels and marsh elevations contributing differently.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves" is correct?
options: 濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。
濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。
兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
optionsEn: Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone.
Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
quiz.explanation: 濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。這是每次漲潮的體積增量，不是整日淨入流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m. Tidal prism is 100000 m³ per flood tide, not a daily net inflow. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。這是每次漲潮的體積增量，不是整日淨入流。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m. Tidal prism is 100000 m³ per flood tide, not a daily net inflow.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves", which statement holds?
options: 兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。
只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。
教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。
optionsEn: A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。核對潮溝和高灘是否在該水位範圍真正被淹，另以流量時間積分檢查一個完整潮週期的入出水量，保留降雨與河川流入的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation. Check which channels and platforms are actually inundated, then compare integrated flow over a complete tidal cycle while accounting separately for rainfall and river inflow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立兩段高程面積曲線，讓低水位時只有潮溝存水，高水位時才淹過平台。用分段積分重算潮汐容積，再降低內部潮差，說明地形與水力限制如何分別改變交換量，並列出需要的觀測資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create a two-part area curve with channel-only storage at low levels and platform inundation higher up. Integrate the prism, reduce internal tidal range separately, and explain how terrain and hydraulic restrictions affect exchange and what observations distinguish them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。核對潮溝和高灘是否在該水位範圍真正被淹，另以流量時間積分檢查一個完整潮週期的入出水量，保留降雨與河川流入的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation. Check which channels and platforms are actually inundated, then compare integrated flow over a complete tidal cycle while accounting separately for rainfall and river inflow.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立兩段高程面積曲線，讓低水位時只有潮溝存水，高水位時才淹過平台。用分段積分重算潮汐容積，再降低內部潮差，說明地形與水力限制如何分別改變交換量，並列出需要的觀測資料。
knowledge.textEn: Create a two-part area curve with channel-only storage at low levels and platform inundation higher up. Integrate the prism, reduce internal tidal range separately, and explain how terrain and hydraulic restrictions affect exchange and what observations distinguish them.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves"?
options: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。
optionsEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
quiz.explanation: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。把漲潮容積再當成淨淡水補充，則忽略退潮排出與舊水返回，容易高估沖洗和水質改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. Treating flood-tide prism as net freshwater supply further ignores ebb discharge and returning old water, exaggerating flushing and potential quality improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教學先使用固定平面面積建立量綱概念，再要求以高程面積曲線和內外水位資料檢查簡化，避免把理想交換量當成實際淨沖洗量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Begin with constant plan area, then examine elevation-area curves and internal levels, keeping gross tidal exchange distinct from net flushing of old water.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。把漲潮容積再當成淨淡水補充，則忽略退潮排出與舊水返回，容易高估沖洗和水質改善。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. Treating flood-tide prism as net freshwater supply further ignores ebb discharge and returning old water, exaggerating flushing and potential quality improvement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。
兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground.
Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
quiz.explanation: 使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淹水歷時與棲地高程」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。理想正弦潮可用來推導某平台高程被淹的時間比例，但真實潮汐包含多個分量、風暴增水及河川作用，不能用一天代表全年。復育評估應讓地形高程和水位使用相同基準，並同時檢查長時間積水及極端乾燥情境。課程算例只描述水理，不把某個淹水比例直接當成所有物種都適合的生態門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淹水歷時與棲地高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe. A sinusoidal tide can estimate the time a platform is submerged, but real tides combine multiple constituents, surges and river effects, so one day cannot represent a year. Align terrain and water-level datums and consider both persistent flooding and drying. The teaching calculation describes hydraulics without treating one hydroperiod fraction as a universal ecological suitability threshold. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inundation duration and habitat elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程
knowledge.text: 濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。理想正弦潮可用來推導某平台高程被淹的時間比例，但真實潮汐包含多個分量、風暴增水及河川作用，不能用一天代表全年。
knowledge.textEn: Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe. A sinusoidal tide can estimate the time a platform is submerged, but real tides combine multiple constituents, surges and river effects, so one day cannot represent a year.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淹水歷時與棲地高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inundation duration and habitat elevation" is correct?
options: 兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。
optionsEn: Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe.
quiz.explanation: 濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。
knowledge.textEn: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inundation duration and habitat elevation", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h。
漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。
植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。
optionsEn: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle.
All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淹水歷時與棲地高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。用實際時序逐點統計淹水時間，檢查取樣間隔及缺值，再將春潮、小潮與季節期間分列，不用理想單一週期取代長期觀測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform. Calculate duration directly from observed time series, review sampling and missing data, and separate spring, neap and seasonal periods rather than replacing long-term behavior with one idealized cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將平台高程改為0.25 m，重算理想淹水比例和時數。再加入固定增水0.20 m，區分地形下降與平均水位上升造成的相似效果，並說明需要哪些基準量測才能辨別兩種成因。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower the platform to 0.25 m and recalculate fraction and duration. Add a separate 0.20 m mean-water increase, distinguish similar effects of terrain lowering and water-level rise, and identify datum observations needed to separate these causes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。用實際時序逐點統計淹水時間，檢查取樣間隔及缺值，再將春潮、小潮與季節期間分列，不用理想單一週期取代長期觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform. Calculate duration directly from observed time series, review sampling and missing data, and separate spring, neap and seasonal periods rather than replacing long-term behavior with one idealized cycle.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將平台高程改為0.25 m，重算理想淹水比例和時數。再加入固定增水0.20 m，區分地形下降與平均水位上升造成的相似效果，並說明需要哪些基準量測才能辨別兩種成因。
knowledge.textEn: Lower the platform to 0.25 m and recalculate fraction and duration. Add a separate 0.20 m mean-water increase, distinguish similar effects of terrain lowering and water-level rise, and identify datum observations needed to separate these causes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「淹水歷時與棲地高程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inundation duration and habitat elevation"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。
每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform.
Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
quiz.explanation: 先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。若只量高潮水位而不記錄時間，也無法分辨短暫越淹與長時間積水，可能使棲地判讀失去關鍵資訊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates. Recording only high water cannot distinguish brief inundation from persistent ponding, removing information essential to interpreting habitat conditions and restoration response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：課程算例只描述水理，不把某個淹水比例直接當成所有物種都適合的生態門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The teaching calculation describes hydraulics without treating one hydroperiod fraction as a universal ecological suitability threshold.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。若只量高潮水位而不記錄時間，也無法分辨短暫越淹與長時間積水，可能使棲地判讀失去關鍵資訊。
knowledge.textEn: A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates. Recording only high water cannot distinguish brief inundation from persistent ponding, removing information essential to interpreting habitat conditions and restoration response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「淹水歷時與棲地高程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inundation duration and habitat elevation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates.
quiz.explanation: 地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
